answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the comet hash is checked against the quill checkpoint at intake, the delta audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
